column3: archive_size                 [non-dominated solutions currently in the archive]
column4: igd                          [Inverted Generational Distance: convergence+coverage; 0=ideal; empty if no reference front]
column5: gd                           [Generational Distance: convergence only; 0=ideal; blind to coverage gaps; empty if no reference front]
column6: hypervolume                  [dominated area vs fixed reference point; larger=better convergence and spread]
column7: spacing                      [std dev of nearest-neighbour distances in the front; 0=perfectly uniform]
column8: spread                       [Deb Delta: extent+uniformity vs true front; 0=ideal; empty if no reference front]
column9: population_feasibility_pct   [% of current population satisfying all constraints]
column10: population_diversity         [mean distance of particles from swarm centroid]
